hypotheses.E0_outlier_modes_have_simple_semantics: After frozen FineWeb label selection, the median top-16 individual-mode AUROC is at least 0.75 on disjoint FineWeb.
hypotheses.E1_individual_semantics_transfer_ood: The same frozen mode labels have median oriented AUROC at least 0.70 on both OOD corpora.
hypotheses.E2_pca_axes_are_semantically_privileged: On every evaluation corpus, the native PCA-mode median exceeds the 95th percentile among 20 random rotations of the identical top-16 subspace by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.E3_outlier_modes_are_more_semantic_than_: Top modes exceed modes 17-32 in median frozen-label AUROC by at least 0.05 on every corpus.
hypotheses.E4_mode_labels_are_diverse: At least five distinct non-position predicates are selected among the top 16 modes.
hypotheses.E5_mode_subspace_contains_semantic_infor: A frozen linear decoder from the top-16 mode scores has median label AUROC at least 0.75 on every corpus.
hypotheses.E6_position_does_not_explain_the_modes: Fewer than half of top modes select an absolute-position predicate.
